title: Review airline foreign ownership limits; screen investors through CFIUS
uncertainties: No DOT review, rule or 119th Congress bill on airline foreign ownership and control limits, or on a CFIUS-based screening framework, was found. DOT citizenship determinations for individual carriers are not published in the Federal Register, the DOT foreign ownership policy page could not be fetched, and the 49 U.S.C. 40102 amendment notes were cut off, so a carrier-specific order or a differently named bill could be missed. The Unified Agenda rule lists on reginfo.gov for DOT and Treasury (both headed 'Agency Rule List - 2026') list no rulemaking on airline ownership limits; the only citizenship entry (2133-AB90) concerns vessels. The 2019 GAO report is background only. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
